# Toysrus HK Sanrio Collection 2026 - All Your Favorite Characters

Toysrus has a dedicated Sanrio zone featuring the complete lineup of beloved characters. From Hello Kitty to Cinnamoroll, My Melody to Pochacco - find exclusive toys, plushies, and collectibles.

## Collection Highlights

- **Hello Kitty** - Latest outfits, accessories, and exclusive plush
- **My Melody** - Classic and limited edition designs
- **Cinnamoroll** - Soft plush collections and keychains
- **Pochacco & Kuromi** - Fun and quirky character toys
- **Sanrio Friends** - Complete sets for collectors

## Why Collect Now

Limited edition items sell out fast. Toysrus HK frequently releases seasonal exclusive Sanrio products not available in other stores. The Christmas season is especially great for finding gift sets.

**[Explore the Sanrio Zone](https://www.toysrus.com.hk/zh-hk/sanrio/)**

> New items added regularly - check back often!

# Toysrus 三麗鷗系列2026 - 熱門角色一次集齊

Toysrus 設有專門的三麗鷗專區，收錄全套熱門角色。從Hello Kitty到玉桂狗、美樂蒂到巴吉度犬，專享玩具、毛絨公仔及收藏品一應俱全。

## 系列亮點

- **Hello Kitty** - 最新服裝、飾品及獨家毛絨
- **美樂蒂** - 經典款及限量設計
- **玉桂狗** - 柔軟毛絨系列及吊飾
- **巴吉度犬 & 酷洛米** - 趣味角色玩具
- **三麗鷗家族** - 收藏家全套組合

## 為何值得收藏

限量商品售完即止。Toysrus 經常推出季節性獨家三麗鷗產品，其他店鋪未必有售。聖誕節期間更適合尋找禮盒套裝。

**[瀏覽三麗鷗專區](https://www.toysrus.com.hk/zh-hk/sanrio/)**

> 新品持續上架 - 建議定期查看！
